name: Menhera & Troll
detailed_description:
Story

A world where the internet is filled with malicious comments and endless arguments.

A genius psychology professor assigns his beloved assistant, "Assistant-kun," to investigate the true identity of internet keyboard warriors and find a way to heal their hearts.

Shocked by the sudden task, Assistant-kun hesitates at first but soon realizes the research is worth pursuing.

Wait…? All the keyboard warriors around me are girls?!

Game play 

As a graduate student in psychology, your mission is to investigate the true identity of keyboard warriors and heal their hearts.

Engage in conversations and help them overcome their inner conflicts!

But beware—if you fail, you’ll be reminded once again of just how fierce they can be.

Game Features

Randomly Generated Situations

This is not a linear story game. Face a variety of unique situations and try to heal the hearts of all the characters!

And if you fail? You’ll be reminded once again that they are, indeed, keyboard warriors.

Fast-Paced Gameplay

These girls won’t wait forever for your response.

Even if you’re handling multiple conversations at once!

Be quick and strategic to win them over.

Charming Characters

Build relationships with the keyboard warriors and uncover their hidden stories.

If you want to heal their hearts, you’ll need to listen to their words carefully.

short_description: What if the keyboard warriors were actually beautiful girls? Become a psychology graduate student and try to heal their hearts. But don’t forget—they are Menhera and trolls! These girls are anything but ordinary.
